The axis is separated and the frozen outcome is reported as measured: correctness is achievable with zero cross-epoch persistence, but not at the declared bar, and the mechanism meant to amortize it was an oracle in disguise. Record four things as this lane's durable contribution. (1) The correctness argument for persistent cross-episode inheritance does not survive on this plan family: an arm with no induced parameters, no cross-epoch compilation and no between-epoch retention closed 100 percent of the residual headroom at 1.0000 span-level action correctness at every novelty rate, 600/600 class-(iii) spans by its own propagated value. (2) The preregistered binding-VALUE cross-epoch cache key is measured to be incapable of compiling class-(iii) spans at all - 0/600 own-mechanism, 600/600 oracle deopt, plus 360 machinery units per 50 episodes for zero hits. Together with the inherited 80 silent false replays this gives a reusable two-sided mechanism statement: a replay key that omits the gating identity is unsound, and a replay key that contains only an episode-scoped value is useless. Transmit it by exact artifact reference to C-PARAM-INHERIT in graph and product as a candidate requirement - bind a stable agent-visible identity and re-validate before replay - and do not touch that claim's status here. (3) Two programme-level measurement definitions are now demonstrably outcome-determinative and are unowned: whether a non-deopting arm's per-span decision is charged as a model unit (48.00 versus 24.00, which is the difference between clause 2 failing and firing and therefore between keeping and narrowing SPIDER's core architecture), and which observable state key defines 'epistemically blocked' (sigma_2 0.2228 versus 0.0800 versus exactly 0 on identical data).
